hypothesis: Faults absent from the USGS/INGENIOUS catalogue are thermo-tectonic fluid conduits: structural boundaries that several independent potential fields see at once, that carry hydrothermal springs, that show potassium-metasomatism alteration in Th/K and U/K, and whose geomorphic scarp is still fresh in 1 m LiDAR. Each mechanism alone has a well-known non-fault mimic; requiring a geometric-mean consensus across all of them suppresses the mimics.
mechanism: Permeability in this terrain is fault-controlled, so a structure that is wet and altered and aerially expressed is a structure. Remote sensing sees the damage zone's potassium halo and the multi-field edge, the DEM/LiDAR sees the scarp, and the spring inventory sees the conduit; no single one of those is sufficient and the consensus is what makes off-catalogue prediction possible at all.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: buried pluton margins and caldera rings (round, multi-field, no scarp, no spring alignment)
alluvial contact springs along basin margins (springs without structure)
regional metamorphic fabric (broad, parallel, survives upward continuation)
landslide headwalls and fluvial cut banks in the LiDAR term
